desc: Noveske enters the PCC game with the new Noveske9, using a dedicated 9mm lower receiver it accepts Colt-style magazines with both a paddle and push button magazine release. Additionally it features an ambidextrous bolt release function and safety levers. Equipped with a 16" stainless 9mm barrel in a 12" RH twist and threaded in 1/2x28 thread pitch that will accept suppressors and muzzle devices. The Noveske9 uses a Gen4 precision machined upper receiver with anti-rotation interface with the M-LOK compatible handguard. A Black Nitride 9mm bolt uses an AR-15 style extractor and is paired with an ambidextrous Geissele Badass charging handle.
